subject: Aligning success criteria & close plan for Nimbus Retail
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha.gomez@nimbusretail.com>, Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@nimbusretail.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning success criteria & close plan for Nimbus Retail

Hi Aisha (and Ravi),

Thanks again for the time earlier—appreciate you making space. Per our conversation, I wanted to get a concise mutual plan on the table so we can align stakeholders, success criteria, and a concrete close timeline. I attached a starter MAP (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx) and our security questionnaire for legal/security (security_questionnaire_v2.pdf).

Proposed high-level milestones: 
- Discovery & success criteria agreed: by 2026-07-18
- Technical evaluation & sample run: 2026-07-19 to 2026-07-30
- Pilot/POC (if applicable): 2026-08-02 to 2026-08-16
- Contract & procurement: target sign by 2026-08-31

Quick asks for you so we can finalize the MAP: 
1) Confirm top 3 success criteria you will use to evaluate (e.g., latency SLA, accuracy thresholds, cost-per-call).
2) Share any additional internal reviewers (procurement, security contact, SRE) and their preferred timing.
3) Let me know whether the 08/31 sign date is realistic or if you prefer an earlier close.

If that schedule looks reasonable I can put together a short 30-minute kickoff with your champion + our SE (Marcus) and solutions PM (Grace) later this week.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachments: Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - draft MAP), security_questionnaire_v2.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Aligning success criteria & close plan for Nimbus Retail

Soojin — thanks for pulling this together. Quick answers from our side: 

Top success criteria (priority order):
1) Response latency under 350ms for customer-facing recommendations (95th percentile)
2) Recommendation accuracy / CTR uplift >= 5% vs baseline
3) Predictable cost per thousand requests within budget band (we'll share target next week)

Stakeholders to include: 
- Ravi Patel (CTO) — technical/architecture decision-maker
- Ben Turner (Procurement) — contracts & PO owner
- Maya Singh <maya.singh@nimbusretail.com> (Product lead for personalization)
- Data infra: Jordan Li <jordan.li@nimbusretail.com> (will help with sample data access)

Timeline note: we are motivated to move faster than 08/31 if the tech evaluation goes well. Can we aim for a procurement window week of 2026-08-17 so legal/proc can have time to review? That would put a target signature around 2026-08-21 to 2026-08-28.

I can host the MAP kickoff — I suggest a 30-minute session Thursday 2026-07-15 at 10:00 PT. Does that work?

Thanks,
Aisha
Head of Customer Experience | Nimbus Retail
Aisha.Gomez@nimbusretail.com

Hi all — quick tech note ahead of the Thursday kickoff: 

- For the sample run we just need a 2-week snapshot (CSV or Parquet) of anonymized recommendation inputs (user/session ids, item ids, timestamps, event labels). "evaluation_dataset_sample.csv" is fine.
- If you have staging endpoints, we'll take read-only access (API key with IP allowlist) — if not, we can run locally against the sample.
- Minimal infra: 8 vCPU, 32GB RAM, and a small GPU for model-parity checks (we can run quantized variants if you prefer no GPU).

I can lead the technical walkthrough during the kickoff and stay for a 45-minute deep-dive if needed.

—Marcus
